title: Mixing and enhanced dissipation in a time-translating shear flow
summary: Motivated in part by the work of Vanneste and Byatt-Smith, we study mixing and enhanced dissipation for the advection-diffusion equation with velocity field $\mathbf{u}(x,y,t)=(\sin(y-ct),0)$, a shear flow whose profile translates rigidly with speed $c$. This is a prototypical example of a flow whose critical points move in time. We quantify how the decay properties depend on the relation between translation speed $c$ and diffusivity $ν$.
